dct_description_sm:
General land uses at a high-level which occur across the Region of Peel in polygon format along with associated attributes.  Assigns a broad category to all lands within the Region, thereby identifying trends and patterns in land uses.

This is easily comparable to the Generalized Land Use (GLU) 2009 and newer.  The GLU created before 2009 use different base data so an exact comparison is not easily calculated.
